item.description: The AsyncIOBackend.open_process method signature doesn't include the user, group, umask, and extra_groups parameters that are being passed from the core subprocess functions, causing TypeError exceptions.
item.contract: Update the AsyncIOBackend.open_process method to accept all subprocess parameters including user, group, umask, and extra_groups with appropriate default values to match the interface contract defined in abc/_eventloop.py.

item.description: Socket path validation fails with "embedded null byte" errors when dealing with abstract socket paths containing null characters.
item.contract: Implement proper validation of socket paths in AsyncIOBackend methods to prevent null byte injection in abstract socket paths, ensuring paths are sanitized before being used in socket operations.
